theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {κ : Cardinal.{w}} [Fact κ.IsRegular] [CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory C κ] (X : C) : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow (CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ).ι X) κ := by
  intro κ' hκ'
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ := CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ
  obtain ⟨hacc, hacc'⟩ := CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory.property C κ
  constructor
  · intro f
    cases f with X' f
    apply CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.map_iff.mp
    exact hι X' f
  · intro c
    apply CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.exists_map.mp
    exact hacc c
